prose: The name Ba’al is feared by Abrahamic religious types, and that aversion has concealed a linguistic key that connects systems of power, priesthood, and rulership across time and history.
We trace the name Ba’al through languages, mythologies, and historical systems, revealing how a single root appears everywhere: Baal, Bel, Bol, Vul, El, Allah, Adonai, Jupiter, Adonis…
topics: The “double doctrine”: exoteric vs esoteric truth
How to spot philological links across cultures (BOL / BL / VL roots)
Mount Meru, pyramids, and the symbolic structure of globalism
Triple Crown of Ba’al: Medieval Papal Bulls & Modern Middle Eastern Wars
ext: In Part 2 we move from symbolism into structure. Ba’al begins to appear not just as a god, but as Dharma, justice, and law itself… We trace a continuous pattern where religion, law, and debt converge into one system.
